'''Comm channel IX-142''' was a communications channel broadcasting a [[METOSP/Legends|METOSP]] warning incoming commercial [[Starship/Legends|starships]] about the [[Blockade of Ralltiir|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].
